masters.title: Lesion morphology prediction during microwave ablation for cancer
masters.degree: MSc Biomechanical & Biomedical Engineering (M2), École Polytechnique · IP Paris
masters.confidential: Industrial internship: this page shows the ideas and methods; clinical images and simulation outputs stay with Hepta Medical.
masters.eli5: Doctors can cook a tumour from the inside with a tiny microwave needle. The hard part is knowing exactly how big the cooked zone gets. I measured it in experiments and rebuilt it in simulations so the device can predict it.

steps.title: The problem
steps.eli5: Heat doesn't spread the same way in a living body.
steps.text: Microwave ablation destroys tumours with heat from a 2.45 GHz antenna. Ablation size follows the delivered energy closely ex vivo (>90 % prediction accuracy) but drops to 50–70 % in vivo.
more: Blood vessels carry heat away (the heat-sink effect)
Tissue contracts and changes its properties as it heats
Perfusion and tissue type change how the zone grows over time; ablation volume isn't linear in delivered energy

steps.title: Measuring temperature from inside
steps.eli5: The needle also works as a thermometer.
steps.text: Hepta's 17G water-cooled monopole antenna integrates radiometric temperature sensing: the heated tissue's thermal radiation is read back as a volumetric temperature around the antenna.
more: Designed and fabricated a new burn fixture
Validated and calibrated the radiometer in water baths at 25 °C and 50 °C, cooling on and off
Phantom burns at 75 W and 100 W to compare antenna and radiometric temperatures

steps.title: Ex vivo burns
steps.eli5: Practise on tissue first, with fake blood vessels.
steps.text: Three kinds of benchmark burns in ex vivo tissue, measured by dissection and automatic MATLAB volume analysis.
more: Fixture burns submerged at 37 °C at 3, 7 and 11 mm from a channel, to mimic perfusion and heat sinks
Half burns to watch tissue contraction directly
Bulky burns for full-size ablation zones
Ablation zones split into coagulation and congestion volumes and correlated with delivered energy

steps.title: Simulation
steps.eli5: Build the same burn inside a computer.
steps.text: Coupled electromagnetic and Pennes bioheat models, validated in 2D and 3D, then 30 fixture simulations (21 liver, 9 lung) across powers and depths.
more: Stationary EM heating source coupled to transient bioheat (weak coupling)
Heat-sink asymmetry grows with power near vessels; asymmetric 54 °C isotherms at 3 and 7 mm
Liver and lung behave differently: in lung the zone grows along the antenna and plateaus
Simulated radiometric signals and real-time ablation volumes

steps.title: Outcome
steps.eli5: The computer and the real burns agree on the trend.
steps.text: A benchmarked simulation framework supporting Hepta's radiometry-based prediction, with experiment–simulation correlation of maximum tissue temperature and ablation volume.
more: Foundation for preclinical analysis and early patient-specific simulations
Tools: COMSOL Multiphysics, MATLAB, ex vivo experimentation, CT image analysis

auv.title: Black Pearl: an autonomous underwater vehicle
auv.degree: BTech Mechanical Engineering, Mahindra École Centrale (Mahindra University)
auv.role: Deputy team lead & mechanical subdivision lead
auv.eli5: A small robot submarine that swims and makes decisions on its own. We designed it, built it, and took it to an international competition.

steps.title: The brief
steps.eli5: Fit a whole robot sub inside a suitcase-sized box.
steps.text: Design a vehicle within the SAUVC rule book and the team's own targets.
more: Rule book: under 70 × 50 × 50 cm and 40 kg in air
Targets: 65 × 47.5 × 47.5 cm, 20–22 kg, 5 active degrees of freedom (surge, sway, heave, roll, yaw)
Slight positive buoyancy (4 %) and pitch within 0–10°

steps.title: A modified V-cycle
steps.eli5: Test on the computer first, then build.
steps.text: A systems-engineering V-cycle adapted for a student team: virtual prototyping, then a decision matrix, then physical prototyping.
more: Every component and the assembly rated 1–5 on stability & speed, modularity & structural integrity, ease of in-house fabrication, and aesthetics
Threshold of 2.5/5 to move to a physical prototype
5 design iterations and 2 loops back to verification; most changes caught virtually, before pre-qualification

steps.title: The final vehicle
steps.eli5: It came out right on target.
steps.text: 60 × 47 × 37.5 cm, 20.6 kg in air, positive buoyancy of 2.91 %, pitch 3–6°, with all 5 active degrees of freedom.
more: Published at MTS/IEEE OCEANS 2021 (San Diego – Porto)
Project funded by École Centrale School of Engineering, Mahindra University

steps.title: Building the team
steps.text: Founded the club from scratch: 15 associate and 10 junior members, finances, logistics, logo, social media, a TV interview and news coverage.
